papers.title: Analgesic Efficacy of Native Himalayan Shilajit as Add-On Therapy in Myofascial Pain Syndrome: An Exploratory Pilot Clinical Trial
papers.translated_title: 喜马拉雅原生Shilajit作为附加疗法在肌筋膜疼痛综合征中的镇痛疗效：一项探索性初步临床试验
papers.author: Basavaraja, D.
papers.summary: BACKGROUND: Myofascial Pain Syndrome (MPS) is a common musculoskeletal pain condition associated with myofascial trigger points that has been reported to occur in 30-93% of patients who present with musculoskeletal pain. The current pharmacologic treatments (such as nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs [NSAIDs], muscle relaxants, and tricyclic antidepressants) are only partially effective and have side effects. Shilajit, a mineral-organic exudate from the Himalayas, has antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, mitochondrial bioenergetic, and central analgesic effects and has not previously been examined as an analgesic in any musculoskeletal pain condition. METHODS: This was an exploratory pilot clinical trial with open-label design in a single arm for an 18-month period at All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Rishikesh, India. Patients aged 18 to 65 years with clinically diagnosed MPS (Simons et al. 1999 criteria) and a baseline visual analog scale (VAS) score >4 were enrolled. Native Himalayan Shilajit 250 mg daily was administered as add-on therapy for 49 days. The main outcome was the percentage of participants with more than or equal to 30% VAS reduction at Day 49. The intensity of pain, the dose of analgesics consumed, and the number of trigger points were evaluated at five time points (Day 0, 12, 24, 36, 49). Throughout, adverse events were monitored. RESULTS: Of 80 enrolled participants, 76 (95.0%) completed the per-protocol analysis. Mean age was 41.25 (SD 9.05) years; 52.6% were male. A total of 56 of 76 participants (73.7%; 95% CI: 62.1-82.8%) achieved the primary endpoint. Mean VAS score declined from 6.63 (SD 1.08) at baseline to 3.63 (SD 1.72) at Day 49 (mean reduction 45.3%; Friedman Chi-square= 278.5, p<0.001). The first signs of pain reduction were seen at Day 24. The number of analgesic doses consumed decreased by 75.5% during the study period (chi-square = 126.1, p<0.001). There was a significant reduction in trigger point count from baseline to Day 49 (p=0.031) of 23.4%. One Grade 2 adverse event (gastrointestinal irritation, Day 28, resolved within 24 hours, no drug discontinuation) occurred; no serious adverse events were reported. Trial registration: CTRI/2025/06/088636. The study was not funded by any external sources. CONCLUSIONS: Native Himalayan Shilajit 250 mg/day for 49 days was associated with clinically and statistically significant reductions in pain intensity, analgesic consumption, and trigger-point burden in patients with MPS, with a favorable safety profile. These findings warrant confirmation in a larger, randomized, placebo-controlled trial.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：肌筋膜疼痛综合征（MPS）是一种常见的肌肉骨骼疼痛疾病，与肌筋膜触发点相关，据报道在出现肌肉骨骼疼痛的患者中发生率为30-93%。目前的药物治疗（如非甾体抗炎药[NSAIDs]、肌肉松弛剂和三环类抗抑郁药）仅部分有效且存在副作用。喜来芝（Shilajit）是一种来自喜马拉雅山的矿物有机渗出物，具有抗氧化、抗炎、线粒体生物能量学和中枢镇痛作用，此前尚未在任何肌肉骨骼疼痛疾病中作为镇痛药进行过研究。方法：这是一项探索性试点临床试验，采用开放标签设计，单臂，为期18个月，在印度瑞诗凯诗全印度医学科学研究所（AIIMS）进行。纳入年龄18至65岁、临床诊断为MPS（Simons等人1999年标准）且基线视觉模拟量表（VAS）评分>4的患者。每日给予天然喜马拉雅喜来芝250 mg作为附加治疗，持续49天。主要结局是第49天VAS评分降低≥30%的参与者比例。在五个时间点（第0、12、24、36、49天）评估疼痛强度、镇痛药剂量和触发点数量。全程监测不良事件。结果：80名入组参与者中，76名（95.0%）完成了符合方案分析。平均年龄为41.25岁（标准差9.05）；52.6%为男性。76名参与者中共有56名（73.7%；95%置信区间：62.1-82.8%）达到主要终点。平均VAS评分从基线的6.63（标准差1.08）降至第49天的3.63（标准差1.72）（平均降低45.3%；Friedman卡方=278.5，p<0.001）。疼痛减轻的首个迹象出现在第24天。研究期间镇痛药剂量消耗减少75.5%（卡方=126.1，p<0.001）。从基线到第49天，触发点数量显著减少（p=0.031），降幅为23.4%。发生1例2级不良事件（胃肠道刺激，第28天，24小时内缓解，未停药）；未报告严重不良事件。试验注册号：CTRI/2025/06/088636。该研究未获得任何外部资金来源。结论：每日250 mg天然喜马拉雅喜来芝治疗49天，与MPS患者疼痛强度、镇痛药消耗和触发点负担的临床及统计学显著降低相关，且安全性良好。这些发现需要在更大规模的随机安慰剂对照试验中得到证实。

papers.title: How do patients move within the Norwegian hospital system? A comprehensive ward- and hospital-level network analysis
papers.translated_title: 患者在挪威医院系统中如何流转？一项全面的病房级与医院级网络分析
papers.author: de Blasio, B. F.
papers.summary: ABSTRACT Patient movements within and between hospitals create networks that can facilitate the spread of nosocomial infections. Many relevant pathogens have long-lasting carriage, allowing colonised patients to move through multiple wards across successive admissions, thereby indirectly linking wards. Yet system-wide ward-level analyses based on individual patient trajectories remain rare, even though they can reveal important features for understanding and simulating the system. We analysed ward- and hospital-level networks using individual patient trajectories from the Norwegian Patient Registry (3.6 million registrations), covering hospital care for ~55% of the population over one year (2012). We characterised the global network structure and, at ward level, calculated multiple centralisation measures and assessed percolation-based connectivity. From these, we identified central wards using directed K-core decomposition combined with Gaussian mixture modelling clustering. Analyses were performed separately for inpatients and all patients, and extended by linking episodes across increasing time gaps to explore how assumptions about episode continuity influence inferred connectivity. Various patient-based statistics were also analysed. Patient movements generated sparse, regionally structured networks with clear core-periphery organisation. Inflow K-cores were larger than outflow cores, with central wards dominated by major hospital referral specialities and medical wards acting as key entry and exit points. Community structure differed by patient type: all-patient networks were largely locally contained, whereas inpatient networks spanned hospitals and regions. Temporal linking increased hub dominance only in all-patient networks, while inpatient structure remained comparatively stable. Dynamic diffusion simulations and a real outbreak analysis independently supported the identified structural backbone, demonstrating that central network hubs also represent the dominant potential pathways of patient-mediated spread under simplified transmission assumptions. The results reveal a robust hierarchical organisational structure of patient movements that can help prioritise surveillance, while underscoring the need for pathogen-specific epidemiological and contextual data for predictive modelling.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 患者在医院内部及医院之间的流动形成了可促进院内感染传播的网络。许多相关病原体具有长期携带状态，使定植患者能够在多次入院中辗转于多个病房，从而间接连接不同病房。然而，基于个体患者轨迹的全系统病房层面分析仍然罕见，尽管此类分析能揭示理解和模拟该系统的重要特征。我们利用挪威患者登记册（360万条登记记录）中的个体患者轨迹，分析了病房和医院层面的网络，覆盖约55%人口在一年内（2012年）的住院护理。我们刻画了全局网络结构，并在病房层面计算了多种中心性度量指标，评估了基于渗流的连通性。在此基础上，我们结合有向K核分解与高斯混合模型聚类，识别出核心病房。分析分别针对住院患者和全部患者进行，并通过跨递增时间间隔连接就诊记录来扩展分析，以探讨关于就诊连续性的假设如何影响推断出的连通性。此外，还分析了多种基于患者的统计指标。患者流动生成了稀疏、区域结构化的网络，具有明显的核心-边缘组织特征。流入K核大于流出核，核心病房以主要医院转诊专科为主，内科病房作为关键入口和出口点。社区结构因患者类型而异：全部患者网络主要局限于本地，而住院患者网络则跨越医院和地区。时间连接仅增加了全部患者网络中的枢纽主导性，而住院患者结构保持相对稳定。动态扩散模拟和真实暴发分析独立支持了所识别的结构骨干，表明在简化传播假设下，核心网络枢纽也代表了患者介导传播的主要潜在路径。结果揭示了患者流动的稳健层级组织结构，有助于优先安排监测工作，同时强调了预测建模中需要病原体特异性流行病学和情境数据。

papers.title: Drug utilization pattern and cost analysis of anticancer drugs among cancer patients attending a tertiary cancer hospital in Nepal: A cross-sectional study
papers.translated_title: 尼泊尔一家三级癌症医院癌症患者的抗癌药物使用模式及费用分析：一项横断面研究
papers.author: Sigdel, N.
papers.summary: Cancer imposes a rising and largely out-of-pocket-financed burden in Nepal, yet patient-level data on how anticancer drugs are prescribed and what chemotherapy actually costs patients remain limited. This study described the drug utilization pattern and cost of anticancer drug therapy among cancer patients treated at a tertiary cancer hospital in Nepal. A descriptive, cross-sectional, record-based study was conducted at Bhaktapur Cancer Hospital, Bhaktapur, Nepal. Medical records of cancer patients aged above 18 years attending the day-care chemotherapy ward were reviewed using a structured proforma. Sociodemographic characteristics, diagnosis, regimen and cycle data, and WHO/INRUD prescribing indicators were recorded, along with the actual cost, maximum retail price, and Nepal Health Insurance Board reimbursement rate for anticancer drug therapy. Data were analyzed descriptively and, given the skewed distribution of cost, on a log-transformed cost variable using Pearson correlation, independent-samples t tests, and multiple linear regression in SPSS version 16. A total of 151 chemotherapy patients were analyzed (mean age 53.81 {+/-} 12.51 years; 67.5% female). Breast cancer (26.5%) was the most common diagnosis. Patients received a mean of 10.56 {+/-} 2.19 total drugs, of which 1.72 {+/-} 0.67 were anticancer agents; 99.85% of drugs were prescribed generically, and 63.2-67.7% were on the national essential medicines list. Mean actual cost of anticancer therapy per patient was NPR 15,245.28 {+/-} 15,672.33, substantially below the mean maximum retail price (NPR 38,803.22). In bivariate analysis, log-transformed cost was significantly higher among male patients (p =.038) and among patients not fully compliant with the essential medicines list (p =.028), but no patient, disease, or prescribing variable -- including sex -- independently predicted log-transformed cost in a multiple regression model that was not statistically significant overall (R{superscript 2} =.113, p =.323). Anticancer prescribing at this hospital was characterized by near-universal generic use but only partial alignment with the national essential medicines list, and chemotherapy cost varied widely across patients without being reliably explained by the patient or prescribing factors examined. These findings support continued WHO/INRUD-style prescribing surveillance and closer attention to essential-medicines-list adherence and drug pricing in this setting.
papers.translated_summary: 癌症在尼泊尔造成的负担日益加重，且大部分费用由患者自付，然而关于抗癌药物如何处方以及化疗实际花费患者多少的患者层面数据仍然有限。本研究描述了尼泊尔一家三级癌症医院癌症患者的药物使用模式和抗癌药物治疗费用。在尼泊尔巴克塔普尔癌症医院开展了一项描述性、横断面、基于记录的研宄。使用结构化表格审查了在日间化疗病房就诊的18岁以上癌症患者的医疗记录。记录了社会人口学特征、诊断、方案和周期数据，以及WHO/INRUD处方指标，同时记录了抗癌药物治疗的实际费用、最高零售价和尼泊尔健康保险委员会的报销率。数据采用描述性分析，鉴于费用分布偏态，对对数转换后的费用变量使用Pearson相关、独立样本t检验和SPSS 16版多元线性回归进行分析。共分析了151名化疗患者（平均年龄53.81±12.51岁；67.5%为女性）。乳腺癌（26.5%）是最常见的诊断。患者平均接受10.56±2.19种药物，其中1.72±0.67种为抗癌药物；99.85%的药物为通用名处方，63.2-67.7%的药物在国家基本药物清单中。每位患者抗癌治疗的平均实际费用为尼泊尔卢比15,245.28±15,672.33，显著低于平均最高零售价（尼泊尔卢比38,803.22）。在双变量分析中，对数转换费用在男性患者（p=.038）和未完全遵循基本药物清单的患者（p=.028）中显著较高，但在总体不显著的多元回归模型中，没有患者、疾病或处方变量（包括性别）独立预测对数转换费用（R²=.113，p=.323）。该医院的抗癌处方特点是几乎普遍使用通用名药物，但仅部分符合国家基本药物清单，化疗费用在患者间差异很大，且无法由所检查的患者或处方因素可靠解释。这些发现支持继续开展WHO/INRUD式处方监测，并在此背景下更加关注基本药物清单依从性和药品定价。

papers.title: Layer-specific cortical signatures uncover a sensory origin of post-stroke motor dysfunction
papers.translated_title: 层特异性皮层特征揭示卒中后运动功能障碍的感觉起源
papers.author: Liu, N.
papers.summary: The cerebral cortex computes through a laminar microcircuit in which superficial layers integrate cortico cortical input and deep layers issue corticospinal output. How focal injury disrupts this input output architecture has been characterized in animal models, but has never been resolved in the human brain, leaving it unknown whether stroke degrades the motor cortex uniformly or dissociates its computational compartments. We used ultra high field 7T functional MRI to resolve activation across cortical depth in the primary motor cortex (M1) hand knob during finger tapping (12 stroke patients/14 controls), and related layer-specific signals to comprehensive motor assessments through principal component analysis, correlation, and cross validated predictive modeling. In the ipsilesional hemisphere, both the input (L2/3) and output (L5) layers showed reduced activation during affected-hand tapping movement in patients compared to controls, indicating a combined failure of sensorimotor integration and corticospinal output. In the contralesional hemisphere, the two compartments dissociated and tracked distinct behavioral processes: superficial (L1) activation varied with global motor outcome, whereas deep output layer (L5/L6) activation tracked specifically with affected hand grip force. Cross validated modeling confirmed this double dissociation: superficial activation predicted global outcome, deep activation predicted grip force, and no ipsilesional layer predicted either. These findings provide the first human evidence that stroke does not disrupt the motor cortex uniformly but reorganizes at the level of individual laminar compartments, with the superficial input stage and deep output stage indexing separable aspects of motor dysfunction. Beyond linking cortical microcircuit models derived from animals to the organization of impairment in humans, layer resolved imaging reveals prognostic information inaccessible to whole region measures, pointing toward laminar signatures that could help stratify motor deficits and guide targeted rehabilitation.
papers.translated_summary: 大脑皮层通过层状微回路进行计算，其中浅层整合皮层-皮层输入，深层发出皮层脊髓输出。局灶性损伤如何破坏这一输入输出架构已在动物模型中有所表征，但在人脑中从未得到解析，因此尚不清楚中风是均匀损害运动皮层，还是使其计算分区分离。我们使用超高场7T功能磁共振成像，在手指敲击任务中解析初级运动皮层（M1）手部区域跨皮层深度的激活（12名中风患者/14名对照），并通过主成分分析、相关性和交叉验证预测建模，将层特异性信号与综合运动评估相关联。在病灶同侧半球，患者受影响手部敲击运动期间，输入层（L2/3）和输出层（L5）的激活均较对照组降低，表明感觉运动整合和皮层脊髓输出存在联合失效。在病灶对侧半球，两个分区分离并追踪不同的行为过程：浅层（L1）激活随整体运动结果变化，而深层输出层（L5/L6）激活特异性地追踪受影响手的握力。交叉验证建模证实了这一双重分离：浅层激活预测整体结果，深层激活预测握力，且病灶同侧任何层均无法预测任一指标。这些发现提供了首个人类证据，表明中风并非均匀损害运动皮层，而是在单个层状分区水平上重组，浅层输入阶段和深层输出阶段分别索引运动功能障碍的可分离方面。除了将源自动物的皮层微回路模型与人类损伤组织相联系外，层分辨成像还揭示了整体区域测量无法获取的预后信息，指向可能有助于分层运动缺陷并指导靶向康复的层状特征。

papers.title: Diabetes and glycemic control as predictors of cardiovascular disease risk biomarkers among people with the metabolic syndrome: a longitudinal analysis
papers.translated_title: 糖尿病与血糖控制作为代谢综合征人群心血管疾病风险生物标志物的预测因子：一项纵向分析
papers.author: Gonzalez Casanova, I.
papers.summary: Background: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is a leading cause of morbidity and mortality among individuals with diabetes, where risk remains elevated even with good glycemic control. Cardiac biomarkers such as N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP), high-sensitivity troponin T (hsTnT), high sensitivity C Reactive Protein (hsCRP), Procollagen Type I Carboxy-Terminal Propeptide (PICP), and 3-Nytrotirosine (3-NT) may capture subclinical cardiac stress and injury beyond traditional risk measures. Methods: We analyzed 562 participants from the PREDIMED-Plus trial with data on diabetes status, glycosylated hemoglobin (HbA1c), and cardiovascular biomarkers. At baseline, participants were categorized as having normoglycemia (HbA1c <5.7%; n=50), prediabetes (HbA1c 5.7 to <6.5%; n=353), diabetes with well-controlled glycemia (HbA1c <7%; n=127), or diabetes with poorly controlled glycemia (HbA1c 7%; n=32). Cardiac biomarkers assessed at baseline, 3 years, and 5 years included NT-proBNP, hsTnT, hsCRP, PICP, and 3-NT. Mixed models, adjusted for demographic, clinical, and lifestyle covariates, were used to examine cross-sectional and longitudinal associations. Results: Cross-sectionally, higher HbA1c was inversely associated with NT-proBNP (= 0.16, 95% CI: 0.29, 0.04) and directly associated with hsTnT (= 0.08, 95% CI: 0.02, 0.14), particularly among those with poorly controlled diabetes. No consistent associations were observed for hsCRP, PICP, or 3-NT. Longitudinally, baseline differences in diabetes status were not significantly related to biomarker changes. However, compared to normoglycemic participants, those with well-controlled diabetes showed higher increases in hsTnT (= 0.10, 95% CI: 0.02, 0.19) and PICP (= 0.14, 95% CI: 0.01, 0.28). Conclusion: Even with adequate glycemic control, individuals with diabetes may experience progression of subclinical cardiac damage and fibrosis. Incorporating cardiac biomarkers into risk assessment may improve early identification of CVD risk in high-risk populations.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：心血管疾病（CVD）是糖尿病患者发病和死亡的主要原因，即使在血糖控制良好的情况下，其风险仍然较高。心脏生物标志物，如N末端前B型利钠肽（NT-proBNP）、高敏肌钙蛋白T（hsTnT）、高敏C反应蛋白（hsCRP）、I型前胶原羧基末端前肽（PICP）和3-硝基酪氨酸（3-NT），可能捕捉到传统风险指标之外的亚临床心脏应激和损伤。方法：我们分析了来自PREDIMED-Plus试验的562名参与者，这些参与者具有糖尿病状态、糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）和心血管生物标志物的数据。在基线时，参与者被分为血糖正常（HbA1c <5.7%；n=50）、糖尿病前期（HbA1c 5.7至<6.5%；n=353）、血糖控制良好的糖尿病（HbA1c <7%；n=127）或血糖控制不佳的糖尿病（HbA1c ≥7%；n=32）。在基线、3年和5年时评估的心脏生物标志物包括NT-proBNP、hsTnT、hsCRP、PICP和3-NT。使用混合模型，调整人口统计学、临床和生活方式协变量，来检验横断面和纵向关联。结果：横断面分析显示，较高的HbA1c与NT-proBNP呈负相关（β = 0.16，95% CI：0.29，0.04），与hsTnT呈正相关（β = 0.08，95% CI：0.02，0.14），尤其是在血糖控制不佳的糖尿病患者中。对于hsCRP、PICP或3-NT，未观察到一致的关联。纵向分析中，基线糖尿病状态的差异与生物标志物变化无显著相关。然而，与血糖正常参与者相比，血糖控制良好的糖尿病患者在hsTnT（β = 0.10，95% CI：0.02，0.19）和PICP（β = 0.14，95% CI：0.01，0.28）方面显示出更高的增加。结论：即使在血糖控制充分的情况下，糖尿病患者也可能经历亚临床心脏损伤和纤维化的进展。将心脏生物标志物纳入风险评估可能有助于在高风险人群中早期识别CVD风险。

papers.title: Exercise-Derived Hemodynamics and 6-Minute Walk Distance in Hypertension
papers.translated_title: 运动源性血流动力学与高血压患者的6分钟步行距离
papers.author: Yu, T.
papers.summary: Abstract Background:Patients with hypertension commonly exhibit reduced exercise capacity. Impedance cardiography (ICG) enables continuous, non-invasive assessment of exercise-derived hemodynamic parameters; however, the relative associations of different ICG-derived parameters with exercise capacity remain unclear. Methods:In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 211 patients with hypertension who completed both ICG assessment and the six-minute walk test (6MWT) were enrolled. Exercise-derived hemodynamic parameters, including maximum heart rate (HRmax), stroke volume (SV), cardiac output (CO), and systemic vascular resistance (SVR), were continuously measured using the PhysioFlow(R) system. Univariable and multivariable linear regression analyses were performed to evaluate the associations between ICG-derived parameters and six-minute walk distance (6MWD). HRmax tertile and subgroup analyses were subsequently conducted. Results:In the final multivariable model, age ({beta} = -2.76, 95% CI, -3.85 to -1.67, P < 0.001), male sex ({beta} = 33.50, 95% CI, 8.40-58.60; P = 0.009), and HRmax ({beta} = 1.26, 95% CI, 0.69-1.83; P < 0.001) were independently associated with 6MWD. 6MWD increased progressively across HRmax tertiles (P for trend < 0.001). The positive association between HRmax and 6MWD remained consistent across all prespecified and exploratory subgroups. Conclusions:Among multiple exercise-derived ICG hemodynamic parameters, HRmax demonstrated the strongest and most consistent independent association with exercise capacity in patients with hypertension. These findings suggest that HRmax may represent the most informative dynamic hemodynamic parameter during exercise and that combining ICG with the 6MWT may provide a simple and accessible complementary approach for evaluating exercise capacity.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景：高血压患者常表现出运动能力下降。阻抗心动图（ICG）能够连续、无创地评估运动衍生的血流动力学参数；然而，不同ICG衍生参数与运动能力的相对关联尚不明确。方法：在这项回顾性横断面研究中，纳入了211名完成ICG评估和六分钟步行试验（6MWT）的高血压患者。使用PhysioFlow(R)系统连续测量运动衍生的血流动力学参数，包括最大心率（HRmax）、每搏输出量（SV）、心输出量（CO）和全身血管阻力（SVR）。采用单变量和多变量线性回归分析评估ICG衍生参数与六分钟步行距离（6MWD）之间的关联。随后进行了HRmax三分位数和亚组分析。结果：在最终的多变量模型中，年龄（β = -2.76，95% CI，-3.85至-1.67，P < 0.001）、男性（β = 33.50，95% CI，8.40-58.60；P = 0.009）和HRmax（β = 1.26，95% CI，0.69-1.83；P < 0.001）与6MWD独立相关。6MWD随HRmax三分位数的增加而逐步增加（趋势P < 0.001）。HRmax与6MWD之间的正相关在所有预设和探索性亚组中保持一致。结论：在多种运动衍生的ICG血流动力学参数中，HRmax与高血压患者运动能力的独立关联最强且最一致。这些发现表明，HRmax可能是运动期间最具信息量的动态血流动力学参数，将ICG与6MWT结合可能为评估运动能力提供一种简单且可及的补充方法。

papers.title: Recurrent Single-Nucleotide Insertions in the Mitochondrial Second Light-Strand Promoter Cause Tubulointerstitial Kidney Disease
papers.translated_title: 线粒体第二轻链启动子中的复发性单核苷酸插入导致肾小管间质肾病
papers.author: Svojsova, K.
papers.summary: Introduction: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) is not routinely analyzed in inherited kidney disease. We evaluated mtDNA variation in families who remained genetically unresolved despite extensive testing. Methods: We reviewed pedigrees from the Wake Forest-Charles University Rare Inherited Kidney Disease Registry to identify genetically unresolved families with suspected maternal inheritance, performed mtDNA genotyping, clinically characterized variant carriers, and functionally evaluated disease-associated mitochondrial variants. Results: Among 33 families with evidence of maternal inheritance, 18 (55%) carried one of seven disease-associated mtDNA variant types, including homoplasmic recurrent single-nucleotide insertions in the second light-strand promoter (LSP2; 9 families), novel MT-TW and MT-TL2 variants (2 and 1 families, respectively), and previously reported MT-TF and heteroplasmic MT-ND5 variant (5 and 1 families, respectively). In 16 families, variants occurred on distinct haplotypes, consistent with independent mutational events and rapid enrichment to homoplasmy across generations. Maternal transmission was strongly supported, with below-normal kidney function observed in 54/60 (90%) offspring of affected mothers versus 1/17 (6%) offspring of affected fathers (p = 1.23 x 10e-11). Pathogenicity was further supported by predicted deleterious structural effects and functional evidence of impaired mitochondrial transcription and translation, respiratory chain deficiency, and CoQ10 depletion. Affected individuals predominantly presented with chronic tubulointerstitial kidney disease, occasionally accompanied by gout and only sporadically with extrarenal manifestations. The rate of kidney disease progression appeared to vary both between and within families. Overall, 109/119 genetically affected individuals or obligate at-risk carriers were clinically affected; most unaffected carriers were younger than 45 years of age. Clinical status was unavailable for an additional 66 obligate at-risk carriers. Conclusions: These findings establish the physiological relevance of the LSP2 promoter, support routine assessment of the mitochondrial genome in inherited kidney disease, and highlight mtDNA variants as an important cause of familial and sporadic tubulointerstitial kidney disease of previously unexplained etiology.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：线粒体DNA（mtDNA）在遗传性肾脏疾病中并非常规分析对象。我们评估了经过广泛检测后仍遗传学未明确的家族中的mtDNA变异。方法：我们回顾了Wake Forest-Charles大学罕见遗传性肾脏疾病登记处的家系图，以识别疑似母系遗传且遗传学未明确的家族，进行了mtDNA基因分型，对变异携带者进行了临床特征描述，并对疾病相关的线粒体变异进行了功能评估。结果：在33个具有母系遗传证据的家族中，18个（55%）携带七种疾病相关mtDNA变异类型之一，包括第二轻链启动子（LSP2）中的同质重复单核苷酸插入（9个家族）、新型MT-TW和MT-TL2变异（分别为2个和1个家族），以及先前报道的MT-TF和异质MT-ND5变异（分别为5个和1个家族）。在16个家族中，变异出现在不同的单倍型上，这与独立的突变事件和跨代快速富集至同质状态相符。母系传递得到强烈支持，受影响的母亲所生子女中54/60（90%）观察到低于正常的肾功能，而受影响的父亲所生子女中仅为1/17（6%）（p = 1.23 x 10e-11）。致病性进一步得到预测的有害结构效应以及线粒体转录和翻译受损、呼吸链缺陷和辅酶Q10耗竭的功能证据支持。受影响个体主要表现为慢性肾小管间质性肾病，偶尔伴有痛风，仅零星出现肾外表现。肾脏疾病进展速率似乎在家族间和家族内均有所不同。总体而言，109/119名遗传学受影响个体或必须风险携带者在临床上受到影响；大多数未受影响的携带者年龄小于45岁。另有66名必须风险携带者的临床状态未知。结论：这些发现确立了LSP2启动子的生理相关性，支持在遗传性肾脏疾病中常规评估线粒体基因组，并强调mtDNA变异是先前病因不明的家族性和散发性肾小管间质性肾病的重要原因。

papers.title: Whole-blood transcriptomic traces of organ pathology and their causal triage
papers.translated_title: 全血转录组学中的器官病理痕迹及其因果分诊
papers.author: Sinha, R. K.
papers.summary: Whole blood offers a non-invasive window into organ health, yet it remains unclear which organ pathologies leave a detectable trace in the blood transcriptome, and whether such traces are causal or reactive. Progress has been limited because paired whole-blood profiles and pathologist-graded organ pathology are rarely available together. Here we assembled a pathology-linked benchmark of 59 pathologies across 20 organs in 803 GTEx v10 donors with matched whole-blood RNA-seq and postmortem histology. Because a postmortem cohort's blood is strongly shaped by age, sex, and the circumstances of death, our framework, TRACE, counts a signal only when blood expression predicts a pathology beyond these donor factors. Four pathologies passed, with liver cirrhosis by far the strongest (AUC 0.79). The cirrhosis signature replicated in an independent cohort of living patients (AUC 0.80) and remained specific against severe systemic illness. To separate candidate drivers from reactive markers, we used human genetics: Mendelian randomization linking plasma proteins to liver disease, which recovered established fibrosis drivers, including PAI-1 (SERPINE1), tenascin-C, thrombospondin-2 and nominated further candidates. Together, TRACE provides a resource and a confounder-aware framework for learning which organ pathologies the blood transcriptome can, and cannot, detect, and which of those signals are likely causal.
papers.translated_summary: 全血为非侵入性观察器官健康提供了一个窗口，但仍不清楚哪些器官病理会在血液转录组中留下可检测的痕迹，以及这些痕迹是因果性的还是反应性的。进展一直受限，因为配对的全血谱和病理学家分级的器官病理数据很少同时可得。在此，我们汇集了一个病理关联基准，涵盖803例GTEx v10供体中20个器官的59种病理，并配有匹配的全血RNA测序和死后组织学检查。由于死后队列的血液受年龄、性别和死亡情况的强烈影响，我们的框架TRACE仅在血液表达能超越这些供体因素预测病理时计数信号。四种病理通过了检验，其中肝硬化信号最强（AUC 0.79）。该肝硬化特征在独立的生活患者队列中得以复制（AUC 0.80），并对严重全身性疾病保持特异性。为区分候选驱动因素与反应性标志物，我们使用了人类遗传学：将血浆蛋白与肝病关联的孟德尔随机化，恢复了已确立的纤维化驱动因素，包括PAI-1（SERPINE1）、腱生蛋白C、血小板反应蛋白-2，并提名了进一步候选。总之，TRACE提供了一个资源和一种考虑混杂因素的框架，用于学习血液转录组能检测和不能检测哪些器官病理，以及哪些信号可能是因果性的。

papers.title: A PRISMA-Aligned Agentic Framework for Medical Systematic Reviews and Evidence Synthesis
papers.translated_title: 面向医学系统综述与证据合成的PRISMA对齐智能体框架
papers.author: Huang, H.
papers.summary: Medical systematic reviews are central to evidence-based medicine, but they remain slow, labor-intensive, and difficult to maintain under the full Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) workflow. Recent LLM-based deep research agents offer a promising route to addressing this challenge, yet reliable deployment in medical systematic reviews remains limited by insufficient clinical domain knowledge and inconsistent adherence to evidence-based methodological standards across the full workflow. We address these gaps with MedSR-Copilot, a PRISMA-aligned multi-agent copilot that decomposes review automation into literature retrieval, coarse-to-fine screening, data extraction, Risk-of-Bias assessment, and evidence synthesis, while preserving structured intermediate artifacts throughout the workflow. We further introduce MedSR-Bench, an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating systems beyond isolated subtasks, from review input to final evidence-synthesis conclusions. MedSR-Copilot completes medical systematic reviews end-to-end under the full PRISMA workflow, achieving 63.6% human-aligned conclusions, 18.3 percentage points above the best baseline among strong general-purpose LLMs and prior automated review systems. In a human-AI collaboration study involving 23 analysis groups across four systematic review topics, MedSR-Copilot, used as a copilot, reduces end-to-end review time by 64.9% and improves final conclusion accuracy by 27.4 percentage points compared with routine-practice workflows. Together, these results demonstrate the reliability and efficiency of MedSR-Copilot as a medical research copilot and suggest a practical path toward trustworthy review automation.
papers.translated_summary: 医学系统综述是循证医学的核心，但它们在完整的PRISMA（系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目）工作流程下仍然缓慢、劳动密集且难以维护。近期基于大语言模型的深度研究智能体为应对这一挑战提供了有前景的途径，然而其在医学系统综述中的可靠部署仍受限于临床领域知识不足以及在整个工作流程中对循证方法学标准遵循不一致的问题。我们通过MedSR-Copilot来弥补这些不足，这是一个符合PRISMA标准的多智能体协同系统，将综述自动化分解为文献检索、由粗到细的筛选、数据提取、偏倚风险评估和证据综合，并在整个工作流程中保留结构化的中间产物。我们进一步引入MedSR-Bench，一个端到端基准测试，用于评估系统超越孤立子任务的表现，从综述输入到最终证据综合结论。MedSR-Copilot在完整的PRISMA工作流程下端到端完成医学系统综述，实现了63.6%的人类对齐结论，比强通用大语言模型和先前自动化综述系统中的最佳基线高出18.3个百分点。在一项涉及四个系统综述主题、23个分析小组的人机协作研究中，MedSR-Copilot作为辅助工具，将端到端综述时间减少了64.9%，并将最终结论准确率比常规实践工作流程提高了27.4个百分点。综合来看，这些结果证明了MedSR-Copilot作为医学研究辅助工具的可靠性和效率，并提出了通往可信赖综述自动化的实用路径。

papers.title: Mapping the flow of data in clinical trials and assessing its CO2 emissions
papers.translated_title: 绘制临床试验中的数据流并评估其二氧化碳排放量
papers.author: Prakasam, H. s.
papers.summary: Background: Healthcare contributes 5% of global carbon emissions, with academic and industry-sponsored clinical trials forming a meaningful share. Existing trial emission frameworks inadequately capture data storage and analysis emissions, leaving their contribution to overall trial carbon footprint poorly understood. Objective: (i) Map the flow of trial data from the investigator site to the final trial documentation and study report in the trial master files (TMF), and identify emissions hotspots (ii) estimate emissions from the hotspots and assess whether they materially impact overall clinical trial emissions. Design: A top-down assessment of enterprise-level trial data volumes and associated emissions, and trial-level data-related emissions analysis of two representative trials. Results: The data flow mapping highlighted three carbon emission hotspots: (a) data analysis in a statistical environment (e.g., entimICE) (b) Trial Master File (TMF) storage, and (c) short-term and long-term data storage by external clinical research organisations (CROs). Within entimICE, the total volume of trial data stored for analysis across all active and recently completed trials at AZ was 100-125TB, stored across four servers in Sweden, generating 80 to 100 tonnes CO2eq annually. TMF storage emissions fell below measurable thresholds. CROs stored substantial data volumes, but per-trial emissions were likely insignificant due to economies of scale in large data centres. Conclusion: To our knowledge, this is the first study to comprehensively assess the carbon footprint of industry-sponsored clinical trial data storage and analysis. The study highlighted the complex network of nodes and junctions involved in managing trial data. The results suggest that carbon emissions from trial data storage and processing are currently a small proportion and unlikely to materially impact overall trial-related emissions. Future research should confirm these results with clinical trials that employ emerging data-intensive computational operations, such as the integration of artificial intelligence (AI).
papers.translated_summary: 背景：医疗保健贡献了全球碳排放的5%，其中学术和行业资助的临床试验占据了相当比例。现有的试验排放框架未能充分捕捉数据存储和分析的排放，导致其对整体试验碳足迹的贡献了解不足。目标：（i）绘制从研究者现场到试验主文件（TMF）中最终试验文档和研究报告的试验数据流，并识别排放热点；（ii）估算热点排放，并评估其是否对整体临床试验排放产生实质性影响。设计：对企业级试验数据量和相关排放进行自上而下的评估，并对两个代表性试验进行试验级数据相关排放分析。结果：数据流映射突出了三个碳排放热点：（a）统计环境（如entimICE）中的数据分析；（b）试验主文件（TMF）存储；以及（c）外部临床研究组织（CRO）进行的短期和长期数据存储。在entimICE中，AZ所有活跃和近期完成试验的存储分析数据总量为100-125TB，分布在瑞典的四台服务器上，每年产生80至100吨二氧化碳当量。TMF存储排放低于可测量阈值。CRO存储了大量数据，但由于大型数据中心的规模效应，每个试验的排放可能微不足道。结论：据我们所知，这是首个全面评估行业赞助临床试验数据存储和分析碳足迹的研究。该研究突出了管理试验数据所涉及的复杂节点和连接网络。结果表明，试验数据存储和处理产生的碳排放目前占比较小，不太可能对整体试验相关排放产生实质性影响。未来研究应通过采用新兴数据密集型计算操作（如人工智能（AI）集成）的临床试验来确认这些结果。
